_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

columns.name: transaction_id
columns.defaultConstraints: UNIQUE REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE

dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: UNIQUE REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "initial_balance_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4279721036, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'account_balance', "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "include_in_net_worth" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("include_in_net_worth" IN (0, 1)), "include_in_available_money" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("include_in_available_money" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_aliases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("account_id", "normalized_alias", "source"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "credit_card_profiles" ("account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "credit_limit_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "closing_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "minimum_payment_minor" INTEGER NULL, "minimum_payment_due_date" INTEGER NULL, "last_statement_amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("account_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'category', "color" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4281956715, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "merchants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "merchant_aliases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "merchant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES merchants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_alias" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "delimiter" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ';', "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "valid_rows" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "invalid_rows" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "duplicate_rows" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "imported_at" INTEGER NULL, "reverted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "occurred_time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'America/Asuncion', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "from_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "to_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "merchant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES merchants (id), "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "payment_channel" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other', "external_fingerprint" TEXT NULL, "source_reference" TEXT NULL, "import_batch_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES import_batches (id), "parent_transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_postings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "delta_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("transaction_id", "account_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_splits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categorization_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100, "source" TEXT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "merchant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES merchants (id), "keyword" TEXT NULL, "transaction_type" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "confidence" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5, "can_auto_confirm" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("can_auto_confirm" IN (0, 1)), "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "confirmation_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "target_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "thresholds" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '50,80,100', "rollover" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("rollover" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "installment_plans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "total_committed_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "installment_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "first_period" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "installment_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES installment_plans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "installment_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "period_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("plan_id", "installment_number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notification_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "envelope_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "package_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "notification_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "notification_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tag" TEXT NULL, "posted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "text" TEXT NULL, "big_text" TEXT NULL, "sub_text" TEXT NULL, "summary_text" TEXT NULL, "text_lines_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "is_update" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_update" IN (0, 1)), "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("package_name", "notification_key", "content_hash"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payment_candidates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notification_events (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "transaction_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'expense', "amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NULL, "raw_merchant" TEXT NULL, "normalized_merchant" TEXT NULL, "suggested_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "suggested_from_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "suggested_to_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "requires_counterparty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("requires_counterparty" IN (0, 1)), "detected_alias" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_confidence" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "merchant_confidence" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "account_confidence" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "overall_confidence" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "suggestion_reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "fingerprint_version" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'v1', "fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dedup_decisions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notification_events (id), "candidate_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payment_candidates (id), "decision" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_rows" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES import_batches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "row_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "original_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "errors_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "fingerprint" TEXT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("batch_id", "row_number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "from_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "to_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "schedule" TEXT NULL, "next_due_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "changes_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
